en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3544 - Abu Jameelah narrated from Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur, from Abu Abdullah (as):
"Write for the runaway slave on a piece of paper or parchment: 'In the Name of Allah (swt), the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
The hand of [slave's name] is tied to his neck. If he extends it, he will hardly see it. And whomever Allah (swt) has not granted light, for him there is no light (Surah An-Nur 24:40).'
Then wrap it, place it between two sticks, and throw it into a dark corner of the house where he used to stay."
